limitations: SLES 12 SP5 userspace on WSL2 kernel, not the SLES kernel or old CPU hardware.
Two controlled server containers/IPs/network namespaces and one client share a modern kernel; no physical NAS isolation, partition/reclaim, server reboot/power-loss or takeover evidence.

Independent source LINK/REMOVE release/drop capability precedes four debug/release real-claim cases, repeated controls in this fixture. All source mounts route through the relay from first mount. Discard includes explicit connection interruption, not universal cancellation, sync/power/server-reboot/old-kernel or full NFS support. Production NFS/source deletion disabled.
Service startup rejection is measured; production NFS and source deletion remain disabled.
